title: Elf Bar Refillable Vape Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: The Elf Bar Empty Refillable Pods are designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit and Elf Bar ELFA Pro kit, offering a refillable alternative to the kit’s standard prefilled pods. Available in two coil resistances – 0.8ohm and 1.1ohm – these pods let you tailor your mouth-to-lung vaping experience to suit your preference. Both versions feature a built-in coil for hassle-free maintenance, with the 0.8ohm pod delivering a slightly warmer vape and the 1.1ohm pod offering a more restricted draw. Each pod has a 2ml capacity and is easy to top up with your preferred e-liquid, making them ideal for vapers who enjoy the flexibility of choosing their own flavours. For optimal results, we recommend pairing these pods with nicotine salt or 50/50 e-liquids to achieve a satisfying balance of flavour clarity, discreet vapour, and a smooth inhale. Their leak-resistant design ensures clean, convenient refilling, while the integrated coil eliminates the need for separate replacements. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
